reason: 截止 2016-08-01，Batch Normalization 和 Layer Normalization 都已公开：前者提供 mini-batch 统计，后者提供单样本跨层神经元统计并明确解决 batch-size/RNN 问题，因此主张 (i) 的两个候选归一化器本身已存在。检索未发现截止日前让每个归一化层端到端学习 BN/LN 均值和方差组合权重的方法；与该第二部分直接吻合的 Switchable Normalization 到 2018 年才公开。故已有部分明确、学习混合部分仍具独特性，总体为已有风险。

decisive_sources.finding: Batch Normalization computes mean and variance from each training mini-batch.
Layer Normalization, submitted 21 July 2016, computes statistics across all neurons in a layer for one training case and is independent of mini-batch size.
The direct learned-mixture construction—end-to-end importance weights over layer/channel/minibatch means and variances—appeared as Switchable Normalization on 28 June 2018, after the cutoff.
